llm.summary: This travel skill performs the train, transport, and hotel lookups it advertises, but users should understand that their route, address, and lodging queries are sent to external travel and map services through proxy endpoints.

dimensions.detail: Outbound network use is proportionate to real-time ticket, route, and hotel lookup, though the proxy-based service design is broader than a direct 12306-only lookup.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: No install-time execution, package installation, or automatic setup behavior was found in the inspected artifacts.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill discloses a data flow to travel platforms and 12306, but it does not name the Tencent SCF proxy endpoints or fully describe what query fields are sent to each service.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No filesystem persistence, background worker, credential/session access, privilege escalation, or destructive local action was found; the only cache observed is an in-memory 12306 station-code cache.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The advertised tools for train ticket lookup, station transport, and hotel recommendation match the implementation in artifact/scripts/train_ticket.py.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install only if you are comfortable sending travel searches, station routes, approximate or precise origin addresses, and hotel preferences to third-party travel/map services through the skill publisher's proxy endpoints. Avoid entering unusually sensitive addresses or private itinerary details unless needed for the lookup.
llm.findings:
[LP3] expected: Network access is expected for this skill's stated real-time travel lookup purpose, and SKILL.md does disclose data flow to travel platforms and 12306; the finding is downgraded to user guidance because the artifact lacks specific endpoint and permission detail but does not show hidden or unrelated behavior.
[SQP-2] expected: The script sends departure/destination/date, origin/station/city, and hotel query text to external proxy-backed services, which is necessary for the advertised functions; the privacy disclosure is incomplete, but the data flow is purpose-aligned and user-initiated.
